notes: Charm has both now (CEO: "add the same code to Charm"). Its cards take the same frosted glass cut from the real wallpaper, and it fades out, moves and fades back in when a new position is clicked. Its Cards blur slider had never done…

The work was shared rather than copied: which layers count as a background, whether a portal paints one at all, and the whole move choreography all live in shared/frost.js and shared/panel-entrance. Charm names its five background layers…

The page's own background now counts as a substrate: Charm's body is opaque until its first background arrives, and frosting a card sitting on an opaque page would be showing wallpaper somewhere wallpaper cannot be seen. A page inside…
